content.short: Aerodrome is the central liquidity and trading hub on Base, combining Velo's tech with Base's ecosystem.
content.description: Aerodrome Finance is a next-generation AMM designed to serve as the central liquidity hub for the Base network. By combining the powerful ve(3,3) flywheel mechanics pioneered by Velodrome with the rapidly growing Base ecosystem, Aerodrome provides a highly efficient trading environment for users and powerful incentives for liquidity providers. The protocol allows for optimized token swaps with low fees and minimal slippage, while its sophisticated governance system enables AERO holders to direct emissions to the most productive pools. As the primary engine for capital efficiency on Base, Aerodrome plays a critical role in the network's decentralized finance landscape.
content.meta: Aerodrome is the leading decentralized exchange and liquidity hub on Base, featuring optimized swap rates and ve(3,3) governance incentives.
